name: Villeta (Colombia)
description: Horizontal tricolour of green, yellow and red, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Villeta with helm and mantling.
history: Municipal flag of Villeta, a municipality in the department of Cundinamarca, Colombia; Colombian municipal flags are adopted by agreement (acuerdo) of the municipal council or by decree of the mayor. Spanish Wikipedia records the flag as adopted on 7 July 1977 (Acuerdo n.º 049).

features.role: Villeta arms — with helm and mantling
